facts.fact: Senegal's regulator ARTP and The Gambia's PURA signed a memorandum of understanding on regulatory cooperation including mutual technical assistance, with ARTP to second a postal regulation expert to PURA; the signing date is not given, so the published date 2026-06-26 is used.
Senegal-Gambia free roaming was introduced in December 2025: travellers receive calls free and make calls at local rates in the visited country for up to 30 days without changing SIM.
